title.zh: 重生后我用系统改写全家命运
title.en: Reborn to Rewrite My Family Fate

master.logline: 被假千金害到家破人亡的真千金重生归来，绑定命运改写系统，靠证据、布局和狠决心，把全家从前世死局里一一救回。
master.synopsis: 林晚月前世被接回豪门林家后，始终活在假千金乔安然的阴影里。父亲因一份伪造合同破产入狱，母亲被慢性下药精神崩溃，哥哥为保护她车祸残疾，而她自己则在认亲宴后的大火中被活活烧死。临死前，她才听见乔安然承认：所谓真假千金，只是林家二叔夺产计划里最温柔的一把刀。再睁眼，林晚月回到认亲宴前七天，并绑定“全家命运改写系统”。系统不能凭空复仇，只会在她做出关键选择时提示前世节点，奖励证据线索和短暂能力。林晚月不再渴望被爱，而是先救人、再清算。她截下父亲的陷阱合同，阻止哥哥车祸，逼出母亲被下药的真相，也让林家第一次看清乔安然的伪善。可随着调查深入，林晚月发现自己的身世另有隐情：当年换婴并非意外，母亲也并非完全不知情。最终，她在林家周年宴上设局反杀二叔与乔安然，却在系统结算时得知，所谓重生并不是天赐机会，而是前世母亲用生命为她换来的最后一次回档。

master.worldview: 现代都市豪门背景，核心围绕林氏集团、真假千金舆论、家族继承权与前世命运节点展开。重生规则为：林晚月回到认亲宴前七天，系统只在关键选择前给出前世提示，每成功改写一个家人悲剧节点，便解锁一段隐藏记忆或证据线索；若她选择逃避或用谎言制造无辜伤害，系统奖励失效。命运可以改写，但必须以真实证据、主动选择和情感代价作为交换。

episodeOutline.title: 重回认亲宴前夜
episodeOutline.hook: 系统奖励的监控碎片揭开惊人关系：乔安然深夜进入林怀远书房，并喊他“爸”，暗示真假千金背后另有夺产阴谋。
episodeOutline.summary: 大火吞没认亲宴后的林宅。林晚月被锁在杂物间，隔着火光听见乔安然轻笑：“真千金又怎样？林家很快就是我爸的了。”下一秒，房梁坠落。她猛地睁眼，眼中火光变成酒店水晶灯——手机日期显示，认亲宴前七天。淡金色字幕浮现：命运改写系统绑定，首个节点：林正廷签署致命合同，失败则林氏破产、父亲入狱。林晚月冲进会议室，正撞见父亲与二叔林怀远准备签约。她夺过合同，所有人震惊。乔安然红着眼上前：“姐姐，你是不是怕爸爸把钱分给我？”林正廷沉下脸，斥她胡闹。前世父亲戴着手铐的画面刺入脑海，林晚月强迫自己冷静，翻到骑缝章处，指出章印错位半毫米，附件页纸张批次不同。律师不耐烦，却被她逼着当场核验电子备案。几分钟后，结果弹出：核心担保附件被替换，金额多出三十亿。会议室死寂。林怀远笑意微僵，乔安然攥紧裙摆。林正廷第一次认真看向这个刚接回来的女儿。系统提示：节点改写成功，奖励监控碎片。画面里，深夜的林怀远书房门开，乔安然低声喊：“爸，林晚月已经开始怀疑了。”
episodeOutline.endingHook: 系统奖励的监控碎片揭开惊人关系：乔安然深夜进入林怀远书房，并喊他“爸”，暗示真假千金背后另有夺产阴谋。

episodeOutline.title: 哥哥车祸倒计时
episodeOutline.hook: 林砚舟开始相信林晚月，并与她拿到沈清禾药检报告；可报告夹层中的十八年前DNA鉴定显示，沈清禾早已接触过换婴真相，母亲的秘密比他们想象得更深。
episodeOutline.summary: 林晚月截下合同后，林家气氛降到冰点。林砚舟表面冷淡，暗中调查她为何知道合同陷阱；乔安然则哭着向沈清禾示弱，暗示林晚月回来只是为了抢走一切。夜里，系统忽然弹出红色倒计时：距离林砚舟车祸，还剩三小时。林晚月追到地下车库，却被监控拍下“尾随哥哥”的画面。与此同时，沈清禾在楼梯间药性发作，情绪失控质问她是不是要毁了这个家。乔安然趁机冲上来尖叫，制造林晚月推母亲下楼的假象，佣人和保镖纷纷围住她。林晚月没有辩解，只盯着倒计时转身冲向车库盲区。系统解锁前世碎片：车祸前，凶手改动的不是刹车片，而是隐藏在备用线路里的控制器。她钻进冷蓝灯下的车底，徒手拔掉装置。几乎同时，林砚舟启动车辆，刹车警报狂闪，车灯逼近柱体。林晚月拉下总闸，车库陷入黑暗，车辆擦着她停下。林砚舟反查行车记录仪，发现真正碰过车的人，是乔安然的司机。第一次，他挡在林晚月身前。两人连夜拿到沈清禾药检报告，却在夹层里发现一份十八年前DNA鉴定：沈清禾，早就知道换婴不只是意外。
episodeOutline.endingHook: 林砚舟开始相信林晚月，并与她拿到沈清禾药检报告；可报告夹层中的十八年前DNA鉴定显示，沈清禾早已接触过换婴真相，母亲的秘密比他们想象得更深。

episodeOutline.title: 全家命运改写完成
episodeOutline.hook: 系统宣布全家命运改写完成，却揭开终极反转：重生并非天赐外挂，而是前世沈清禾用生命和玉坠为林晚月换来的最后一次机会。
episodeOutline.summary: 林氏周年宴金光璀璨，林怀远却在董事与媒体面前提前发难，甩出林正廷涉嫌违规交易的材料，逼董事会临场改选。乔安然红着眼站到镜头前，控诉自己被林晚月霸凌、被林家抛弃，舆论瞬间倒向她。林正廷脸色惨白，沈清禾指尖发抖，所有人都看向林晚月。她却没有退，直接打开大屏：“今晚，谁都别想再用体面遮丑。”第一段录音，是林怀远指使秘书替换合同；第二条转账链，连到制造林砚舟车祸的空壳公司；第三份病历，证明沈清禾多年被私人医生慢性下药。林怀远反咬她伪造证据，乔安然扑上前哭喊。沈清禾却摘下玉坠，当众承认当年她察觉换婴，却被林怀远用婴儿安全威胁，被药物控制到无人相信。玉坠里最后一段录音响起：林怀远亲口承认乔安然是他的私生女，抱错从一开始就是夺产局。警笛逼近，林怀远被带走，乔安然崩溃冲向林晚月，被林砚舟拦下。林正廷终于低头道歉，沈清禾抱住晚月泣不成声。系统金字浮现：全家命运改写完成。可下一秒，结算画面碎裂，前世火场中，沈清禾跪在她焦黑尸身旁握碎玉坠，低声说：“用我的命，换她重来一次。”林晚月泪水落下，才懂系统不是奖励，是母亲迟来的爱。
episodeOutline.endingHook: 系统宣布全家命运改写完成，却揭开终极反转：重生并非天赐外挂，而是前世沈清禾用生命和玉坠为林晚月换来的最后一次机会。

shots.aiPromptEn: English prompt: vertical 9:16 cinematic AI drama with consistent character design, suitable for image-to-video and text-to-video production. Lin Wanyue is a young elegant woman in her early twenties, long black hair, pale face, sharp expressive eyes; her emotion evolves from terrified survivor to calm avenger. Open inside the burning Lin mansion after a recognition banquet: charred doorframe and twisted chains dominate the foreground, Lin Wanyue sits trapped in a storage room with soot and blood on her face, flames pouring through the door crack and window lattice. In the background, red banquet ribbons, a shattered champagne tower and a collapsed flower wall burn. Qiao Anran appears half-hidden beyond the fire in a pale dress, smiling softly, dropping a key into the flames. Use a low-angle close-up from Lin Wanyue’s trembling fingers to her firelit eyes, then rack focus through the door crack to Qiao Anran’s blurred smile; a falling beam shadow crushes the frame and cuts to black. Match cut to a hotel suite: fire reflections become warm white crystal chandelier light in her pupils. She wakes, checks her unburned neck and wrists, grabs the phone showing seven days before the banquet. Pale golden system text floats between her and the mirror: fate rewrite system bound, first node: Lin Zhengting signs a deadly contract, failure means Lin Group bankruptcy and father imprisoned. She suppresses fear, hardens her gaze, throws on a coat and runs out. Cut to the Lin hotel conference room: long table, executives and lawyers, cold business lighting. Lin Zhengting is about to sign, Lin Huaiyuan sits at his right with a controlled smile, Qiao Anran stands behind him pretending to be gentle and wronged. Extreme close-up of the pen tip on the signature line, then handheld tracking as Lin Wanyue bursts in against backlight, presses down the contract and snatches it away. Show tense reaction shots: father angry, Qiao Anran teary, Lin Huaiyuan’s smile stiffening. Final sequence: the contract lies open on the table, macro shots of a half-millimeter misaligned seam seal, different paper fibers on the attachment pages, electronic filing numbers loading on a projected screen. The lawyer turns pale as the pop-up reveals the core guarantee attachment was replaced and the guarantee amount increased by three billion. The room falls silent; Lin Zhengting looks at his daughter seriously for the first time, Lin Huaiyuan hides panic, Qiao Anran clenches her skirt until her knuckles whiten. A cold system notification announces success, then overlay a black-and-white surveillance fragment with timecode and static: late-night study door opening, Qiao Anran checks the corridor, enters the shadows and whispers to Lin Huaiyuan, calling him Dad. Emphasize realistic acting, micro-expressions, suspenseful pacing, layered spatial depth, shallow depth of field, orange-red fire contrast, warm hotel lighting, cold blue meeting-room tension, black-and-white noisy CCTV texture, with audible flames, breaking wood, glass bursts, phone vibration, air conditioner hum, paper rustle, mouse clicks and electronic static.

shots.camera: 镜头语言：极近景拍她睁眼，瞳孔中的火光通过匹配剪辑变成水晶灯反光；镜头后退成中近景，手机日期入画，再用轻微环绕展现她确认房间真实。系统文字以浅景深悬浮在前景，人物在后景保持清晰，强调现实与超自然叠加。
shots.action: 人物动作：林晚月先本能摸向脖颈和手腕，确认没有烧伤；她抓起手机，手指因惊魂未定而发抖，看到日期后呼吸停了一拍。系统字幕浮现时，她没有尖叫，只是闭眼压住恐惧，再睁眼时眼神变硬，迅速下床披外套冲向门口。
shots.dialogue: 林晚月轻声自语：“七天前……我回来了。”系统无机质提示：“节点倒计时开始。”林晚月压低声音：“那就从这份合同开始。”
shots.sound: 水晶灯细微电流声、手机震动声、心跳低频逐渐加重；系统提示音干净冰冷，与她急促呼吸形成对比。她赤脚落地时地毯闷响，随后门被推开的声音干脆有力。
shots.emotion: 情绪与戏剧目的：完成重生与系统规则交代，让林晚月从惊恐迅速进入行动状态，明确本集目标是阻止父亲签约。

shots.visual: 画面设计：林氏酒店会议室，长桌两侧坐满高管与律师，林正廷坐主位，林怀远坐他右侧，面前合同已翻到签字页；乔安然穿浅色裙装站在林正廷身后半步，姿态温顺。会议室门被猛地推开，林晚月逆光闯入，前景是即将落笔的钢笔尖，中景是所有人惊愕抬头，空间秩序被她打断。
shots.camera: 镜头语言：先给钢笔尖压在签字栏上的特写，笔尖刚要划下时，门声响起，快速横移到林晚月冲入；中景手持感跟随她穿过长桌侧边，制造失控感。她夺合同瞬间切近景，合同纸张掠过镜头，随后反打林正廷沉下的脸与乔安然泛红的眼眶。
shots.action: 人物动作：林晚月冲到父亲身边，一把按住合同，另一只手夺过整份文件，身体微微发抖但站得很稳。林正廷眉头紧锁，钢笔悬在半空；林怀远笑容停在脸上，手指轻敲桌面掩饰不悦。乔安然立刻上前半步，眼眶含泪，手轻轻扶住林正廷椅背，把自己放在受委屈的位置。
shots.dialogue: 乔安然哽咽：“姐姐，你是不是怕爸爸把钱分给我？”林正廷压着火：“晚月，放下，别在外人面前胡闹。”林晚月看着父亲：“这不是钱，是你的命。”

shots.aiPromptEn: English prompt: vertical 9:16 cinematic AI drama with consistent character design, suitable for image-to-video and text-to-video production. Lin Wanyue is a young elegant woman in her early twenties, long black hair, pale face, sharp expressive eyes; her emotion evolves from terrified survivor to calm avenger. Open inside the burning Lin mansion after a recognition banquet: charred doorframe and twisted chains dominate the foreground, Lin Wanyue sits trapped in a storage room with soot and blood on her face, flames pouring through the door crack and window lattice. In the background, red banquet ribbons, a shattered champagne tower and a collapsed flower wall burn. Qiao Anran appears half-hidden beyond the fire in a pale dress, smiling softly, dropping a key into the flames. Use a low-angle close-up from Lin Wanyue’s trembling fingers to her firelit eyes, then rack focus through the door crack to Qiao Anran’s blurred smile; a falling beam shadow crushes the frame and cuts to black. Match cut to a hotel suite: fire reflections become warm white crystal chandelier light in her pupils. She wakes, checks her unburned neck and wrists, grabs the phone showing seven days before the banquet. Pale golden system text floats between her and the mirror: fate rewrite system bound, first node: Lin Zhengting signs a deadly contract, failure means Lin Group bankruptcy and father imprisoned. She suppresses fear, hardens her gaze, throws on a coat and runs out. Cut to the Lin hotel conference room: long table, executives and lawyers, cold business lighting. Lin Zhengting is about to sign, Lin Huaiyuan sits at his right with a controlled smile, Qiao Anran stands behind him pretending to be gentle and wronged. Extreme close-up of the pen tip on the signature line, then handheld tracking as Lin Wanyue bursts in against backlight, presses down the contract and snatches it away. Show tense reaction shots: father angry, Qiao Anran teary, Lin Huaiyuan’s smile stiffening. Final sequence: the contract lies open on the table, macro shots of a half-millimeter misaligned seam seal, different paper fibers on the attachment pages, electronic filing numbers loading on a projected screen. The lawyer turns pale as the pop-up reveals the core guarantee attachment was replaced and the guarantee amount increased by three billion. The room falls silent; Lin Zhengting looks at his daughter seriously for the first time, Lin Huaiyuan hides panic, Qiao Anran clenches her skirt until her knuckles whiten. A cold system notification announces success, then overlay a black-and-white surveillance fragment with timecode and static: late-night study door opening, Qiao Anran checks the corridor, enters the shadows and whispers to Lin Huaiyuan, calling him Dad. Emphasize realistic acting, micro-expressions, suspenseful pacing, layered spatial depth, shallow depth of field, orange-red fire contrast, warm hotel lighting, cold blue meeting-room tension, black-and-white noisy CCTV texture, with audible flames, breaking wood, glass bursts, phone vibration, air conditioner hum, paper rustle, mouse clicks and electronic static.

shots.camera: 镜头语言：合同细节用连续特写呈现，骑缝章上下错位半毫米、附件页纸纤维纹理不同、备案编号在电脑屏上跳动；随后推成林晚月稳定的中近景，她的手指按在证据上不移开。弹窗出现时给全场静止的宽镜头，再用三连反应近景切林正廷、林怀远、乔安然。结尾监控碎片采用俯视黑白监控视角，画面边缘带时间码与轻微噪点。
shots.action: 人物动作：林晚月强迫自己放慢语速，逐页翻给律师看，指尖压住关键处，避免合同被人抽走。律师先不耐烦地推眼镜，核验后脸色发白。林正廷的怒意从脸上退去，第一次认真审视她；林怀远下颌绷紧，随即又试图恢复微笑；乔安然指节发白，裙摆被攥出褶皱。监控里，乔安然进门后迅速回头确认走廊无人。
shots.dialogue: 林晚月：“章印错位，附件纸张批次也不对。现在查电子备案。”律师低声：“备案附件……被替换了。”林晚月看向父亲：“如果你签了，林家替他们担三十亿。”系统提示：“节点改写成功，奖励监控碎片。”监控中乔安然低声：“爸，林晚月已经开始怀疑了。”
shots.sound: 纸页翻动声被放大，鼠标点击声清晰，备案进度条加载时有细小电子蜂鸣；弹窗出现后所有环境声骤然压低，只剩众人呼吸。系统提示音冰冷落下，随即切入监控画面的电流杂音与远处书房门轴轻响。
shots.emotion: 情绪与戏剧目的：完成林晚月首次改写命运节点，用确凿证据逆转会议室权力关系，并以乔安然喊林怀远“爸”的监控碎片抛出真假千金背后的夺产阴谋钩子。

editingNotes: 完成重生开局，交代前世死亡与系统规则，并让林晚月第一次主动改写父亲破产入狱的关键节点。
林家人更信任多年相处的乔安然和林怀远，林晚月突然阻止签约被视为无理取闹，她必须在被亲人误解的压力下用证据证明合同有诈。
系统奖励的监控碎片揭开惊人关系：乔安然深夜进入林怀远书房，并喊他“爸”，暗示真假千金背后另有夺产阴谋。

aiManhuaDrama.scriptText: 大火吞没认亲宴后的林宅。林晚月被锁在杂物间，隔着火光听见乔安然轻笑：“真千金又怎样？林家很快就是我爸的了。”下一秒，房梁坠落。她猛地睁眼，眼中火光变成酒店水晶灯——手机日期显示，认亲宴前七天。淡金色字幕浮现：命运改写系统绑定，首个节点：林正廷签署致命合同，失败则林氏破产、父亲入狱。林晚月冲进会议室，正撞见父亲与二叔林怀远准备签约。她夺过合同，所有人震惊。乔安然红着眼上前：“姐姐，你是不是怕爸爸把钱分给我？”林正廷沉下脸，斥她胡闹。前世父亲戴着手铐的画面刺入脑海，林晚月强迫自己冷静，翻到骑缝章处，指出章印错位半毫米，附件页纸张批次不同。律师不耐烦，却被她逼着当场核验电子备案。几分钟后，结果弹出：核心担保附件被替换，金额多出三十亿。会议室死寂。林怀远笑意微僵，乔安然攥紧裙摆。林正廷第一次认真看向这个刚接回来的女儿。系统提示：节点改写成功，奖励监控碎片。画面里，深夜的林怀远书房门开，乔安然低声喊：“爸，林晚月已经开始怀疑了。”

panels.aiPromptEn: English prompt: vertical 9:16 cinematic AI drama with consistent character design, suitable for image-to-video and text-to-video production. Lin Wanyue is a young elegant woman in her early twenties, long black hair, pale face, sharp expressive eyes; her emotion evolves from terrified survivor to calm avenger. Open inside the burning Lin mansion after a recognition banquet: charred doorframe and twisted chains dominate the foreground, Lin Wanyue sits trapped in a storage room with soot and blood on her face, flames pouring through the door crack and window lattice. In the background, red banquet ribbons, a shattered champagne tower and a collapsed flower wall burn. Qiao Anran appears half-hidden beyond the fire in a pale dress, smiling softly, dropping a key into the flames. Use a low-angle close-up from Lin Wanyue’s trembling fingers to her firelit eyes, then rack focus through the door crack to Qiao Anran’s blurred smile; a falling beam shadow crushes the frame and cuts to black. Match cut to a hotel suite: fire reflections become warm white crystal chandelier light in her pupils. She wakes, checks her unburned neck and wrists, grabs the phone showing seven days before the banquet. Pale golden system text floats between her and the mirror: fate rewrite system bound, first node: Lin Zhengting signs a deadly contract, failure means Lin Group bankruptcy and father imprisoned. She suppresses fear, hardens her gaze, throws on a coat and runs out. Cut to the Lin hotel conference room: long table, executives and lawyers, cold business lighting. Lin Zhengting is about to sign, Lin Huaiyuan sits at his right with a controlled smile, Qiao Anran stands behind him pretending to be gentle and wronged. Extreme close-up of the pen tip on the signature line, then handheld tracking as Lin Wanyue bursts in against backlight, presses down the contract and snatches it away. Show tense reaction shots: father angry, Qiao Anran teary, Lin Huaiyuan’s smile stiffening. Final sequence: the contract lies open on the table, macro shots of a half-millimeter misaligned seam seal, different paper fibers on the attachment pages, electronic filing numbers loading on a projected screen. The lawyer turns pale as the pop-up reveals the core guarantee attachment was replaced and the guarantee amount increased by three billion. The room falls silent; Lin Zhengting looks at his daughter seriously for the first time, Lin Huaiyuan hides panic, Qiao Anran clenches her skirt until her knuckles whiten. A cold system notification announces success, then overlay a black-and-white surveillance fragment with timecode and static: late-night study door opening, Qiao Anran checks the corridor, enters the shadows and whispers to Lin Huaiyuan, calling him Dad. Emphasize realistic acting, micro-expressions, suspenseful pacing, layered spatial depth, shallow depth of field, orange-red fire contrast, warm hotel lighting, cold blue meeting-room tension, black-and-white noisy CCTV texture, with audible flames, breaking wood, glass bursts, phone vibration, air conditioner hum, paper rustle, mouse clicks and electronic static.

panels.camera: 镜头语言：极近景拍她睁眼，瞳孔中的火光通过匹配剪辑变成水晶灯反光；镜头后退成中近景，手机日期入画，再用轻微环绕展现她确认房间真实。系统文字以浅景深悬浮在前景，人物在后景保持清晰，强调现实与超自然叠加。
panels.action: 人物动作：林晚月先本能摸向脖颈和手腕，确认没有烧伤；她抓起手机，手指因惊魂未定而发抖，看到日期后呼吸停了一拍。系统字幕浮现时，她没有尖叫，只是闭眼压住恐惧，再睁眼时眼神变硬，迅速下床披外套冲向门口。

panels.emotion: 情绪与戏剧目的：完成重生与系统规则交代，让林晚月从惊恐迅速进入行动状态，明确本集目标是阻止父亲签约。

panels.camera: 镜头语言：先给钢笔尖压在签字栏上的特写，笔尖刚要划下时，门声响起，快速横移到林晚月冲入；中景手持感跟随她穿过长桌侧边，制造失控感。她夺合同瞬间切近景，合同纸张掠过镜头，随后反打林正廷沉下的脸与乔安然泛红的眼眶。
panels.action: 人物动作：林晚月冲到父亲身边，一把按住合同，另一只手夺过整份文件，身体微微发抖但站得很稳。林正廷眉头紧锁，钢笔悬在半空；林怀远笑容停在脸上，手指轻敲桌面掩饰不悦。乔安然立刻上前半步，眼眶含泪，手轻轻扶住林正廷椅背，把自己放在受委屈的位置。
panels.dialogue: 乔安然哽咽：“姐姐，你是不是怕爸爸把钱分给我？”林正廷压着火：“晚月，放下，别在外人面前胡闹。”林晚月看着父亲：“这不是钱，是你的命。”
panels.sound: 会议室空调低鸣、钢笔笔帽轻碰桌面的细响、合同纸张被夺走的哗啦声；众人压低的吸气与窃窃私语浮起，林晚月说最后一句时背景声短暂抽空。

shots.aiPromptEn: English prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical cinematic AI drama / AI comic-video sequence with consistent character design and a cold luxury suspense tone. Lin Wanyue is a young restrained woman with slightly messy long hair, pale elegant clothing, determined eyes; Lin Yanzhou is tall, cold, in a dark tailored suit, often half-lit by shadow; Qiao Anran appears fragile and tearful in a refined dress, but with hidden malice; Shen Qinghe is an elegant wealthy mother, flushed and unstable due to medication. Start in the Lin family reception room under low cold-white chandeliers: the intercepted contract lies open on a long table, Wanyue presses the pages with white knuckles, Yanzhou watches from the opposite end, Anran clings to Qinghe’s sleeve while servants freeze by the doorway. Use a slow lateral medium-wide move across the contract clauses, then push to Yanzhou’s suspicious eyes and rack focus to Anran’s tearful face. Cut to a night corridor: a red system countdown reflects in Wanyue’s pupils, three hours before Yanzhou’s car crash. Handheld follow her rushing downstairs into a cold-blue underground garage; switch to high surveillance angle with timestamp, showing her apparently tailing Yanzhou near a black sedan. In the stairwell, mix warm and cold light as medicated Qinghe loses control; Anran rushes in and stages a false perspective of Wanyue pushing her mother, while guards and servants close in. Wanyue ignores the accusation and follows the countdown to the garage blind spot. Low under-car close-ups show her oil-stained, bleeding hands searching the backup wiring; flash fragments reveal the hidden controller, not the brake pads. Yanzhou starts the car, brake warning lights flash red, headlights rush toward a concrete pillar. Wanyue pulls the main breaker, instant blackout, tire screech, the car stops inches from her. End in a late-night study: overhead static shot of dashcam footage showing Anran’s driver touching the car, Qinghe’s toxicology report, and an eighteen-year-old DNA test hidden in the file; Yanzhou steps half a pace in front of Wanyue for the first time. Emphasize realistic acting, layered foreground-midground-background depth, cold blue versus alarm red lighting, detailed skin texture, fabric folds, paper fibers, oily reflections, wet concrete floor, tense environmental sound, surveillance distortion, handheld urgency, low-angle impact, and a final silent evidence reveal.

shots.camera: 从林晚月瞳孔特写开始，红色倒计时反射在眼中；急切手持跟拍她下楼，步伐不稳但目标明确。进入车库后切为固定高位监控视角，广角畸变强化她尾随林砚舟的误会；再切近景捕捉她看到监控摄像头时短暂僵住。
shots.action: 林晚月握紧手机，呼吸猛然断了一拍，随即提裙奔跑；她在车库入口停半秒，看到监控红点闪烁，眼神明白自己已经被拍下，却仍继续追。林砚舟没有回头，只按下车钥匙，车灯亮起。
shots.dialogue: 系统提示音冰冷：倒计时启动。林晚月压着喘息低声：这次不能再晚。林砚舟背对她说：别再跟着我。
shots.sound: 手机警报短促刺耳，楼梯急促脚步声，地下车库空旷回响，车锁解开的滴声，监控电流噪点与心跳低频叠加。
shots.emotion: 戏剧目的：明确车祸倒计时与时间压力，同时制造对林晚月极不利的监控证据；观众知道她在救人，剧中人物却会把她看成尾随者。

shots.visual: 楼梯间冷暖光交界，沈清禾扶着扶手站在台阶上方，脸色潮红、瞳孔发散，药性发作让她情绪失控。林晚月从下方返回取车库盲区路线图时被拦住。乔安然从侧门冲入，裙摆凌乱，故意撞向两人之间，画面瞬间形成沈清禾向后踉跄、林晚月伸手的错位假象。佣人和保镖从楼梯口涌出，把林晚月围在中心。
shots.camera: 楼梯下方仰拍沈清禾，压迫感强；乔安然冲入时用快速横移跟随，制造视觉混乱。关键一刻切侧逆光定格式构图：林晚月的手悬在半空，沈清禾后仰，乔安然尖叫在前景，观众能看到林晚月其实没有碰到她，但围观者视角被遮挡。随后环绕半圈拍保镖收紧包围。
shots.action: 沈清禾指着林晚月，手指颤抖，声音发虚却尖利；林晚月本能伸手想扶，立刻意识到陷阱，手僵在半空。乔安然扑到沈清禾身边，眼泪来得极快，抬头看林晚月时闪过挑衅。林晚月没有辩解，只低头看手机倒计时，瞳孔收紧，转身冲向车库盲区。
shots.dialogue: 沈清禾失控质问：你回来，就是要毁了我们吗？乔安然尖叫：别碰妈妈！你为什么要推她！林晚月咬字很轻：让开。
shots.sound: 楼梯间回声尖锐，沈清禾紊乱喘息，乔安然撕裂的尖叫，保镖皮鞋踏上台阶，手机倒计时滴答声逐渐盖过人声。
shots.emotion: 戏剧目的：完成栽赃，形成林晚月被全家围堵的高压局面；她放弃自证选择先救人，突出孤勇与时间冲突。

panels.aiPromptEn: English prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical cinematic AI drama / AI comic-video sequence with consistent character design and a cold luxury suspense tone. Lin Wanyue is a young restrained woman with slightly messy long hair, pale elegant clothing, determined eyes; Lin Yanzhou is tall, cold, in a dark tailored suit, often half-lit by shadow; Qiao Anran appears fragile and tearful in a refined dress, but with hidden malice; Shen Qinghe is an elegant wealthy mother, flushed and unstable due to medication. Start in the Lin family reception room under low cold-white chandeliers: the intercepted contract lies open on a long table, Wanyue presses the pages with white knuckles, Yanzhou watches from the opposite end, Anran clings to Qinghe’s sleeve while servants freeze by the doorway. Use a slow lateral medium-wide move across the contract clauses, then push to Yanzhou’s suspicious eyes and rack focus to Anran’s tearful face. Cut to a night corridor: a red system countdown reflects in Wanyue’s pupils, three hours before Yanzhou’s car crash. Handheld follow her rushing downstairs into a cold-blue underground garage; switch to high surveillance angle with timestamp, showing her apparently tailing Yanzhou near a black sedan. In the stairwell, mix warm and cold light as medicated Qinghe loses control; Anran rushes in and stages a false perspective of Wanyue pushing her mother, while guards and servants close in. Wanyue ignores the accusation and follows the countdown to the garage blind spot. Low under-car close-ups show her oil-stained, bleeding hands searching the backup wiring; flash fragments reveal the hidden controller, not the brake pads. Yanzhou starts the car, brake warning lights flash red, headlights rush toward a concrete pillar. Wanyue pulls the main breaker, instant blackout, tire screech, the car stops inches from her. End in a late-night study: overhead static shot of dashcam footage showing Anran’s driver touching the car, Qinghe’s toxicology report, and an eighteen-year-old DNA test hidden in the file; Yanzhou steps half a pace in front of Wanyue for the first time. Emphasize realistic acting, layered foreground-midground-background depth, cold blue versus alarm red lighting, detailed skin texture, fabric folds, paper fibers, oily reflections, wet concrete floor, tense environmental sound, surveillance distortion, handheld urgency, low-angle impact, and a final silent evidence reveal.

panels.visual: 楼梯间冷暖光交界，沈清禾扶着扶手站在台阶上方，脸色潮红、瞳孔发散，药性发作让她情绪失控。林晚月从下方返回取车库盲区路线图时被拦住。乔安然从侧门冲入，裙摆凌乱，故意撞向两人之间，画面瞬间形成沈清禾向后踉跄、林晚月伸手的错位假象。佣人和保镖从楼梯口涌出，把林晚月围在中心。
panels.camera: 楼梯下方仰拍沈清禾，压迫感强；乔安然冲入时用快速横移跟随，制造视觉混乱。关键一刻切侧逆光定格式构图：林晚月的手悬在半空，沈清禾后仰，乔安然尖叫在前景，观众能看到林晚月其实没有碰到她，但围观者视角被遮挡。随后环绕半圈拍保镖收紧包围。
panels.action: 沈清禾指着林晚月，手指颤抖，声音发虚却尖利；林晚月本能伸手想扶，立刻意识到陷阱，手僵在半空。乔安然扑到沈清禾身边，眼泪来得极快，抬头看林晚月时闪过挑衅。林晚月没有辩解，只低头看手机倒计时，瞳孔收紧，转身冲向车库盲区。
panels.dialogue: 沈清禾失控质问：你回来，就是要毁了我们吗？乔安然尖叫：别碰妈妈！你为什么要推她！林晚月咬字很轻：让开。
panels.sound: 楼梯间回声尖锐，沈清禾紊乱喘息，乔安然撕裂的尖叫，保镖皮鞋踏上台阶，手机倒计时滴答声逐渐盖过人声。
panels.emotion: 戏剧目的：完成栽赃，形成林晚月被全家围堵的高压局面；她放弃自证选择先救人，突出孤勇与时间冲突。

panels.visual: 地下车库盲区，冷蓝灯管忽明忽暗，林晚月钻进黑色轿车底部，掌心沾满机油，前世碎片以短促闪回叠在画面边缘：不是刹车片，而是备用线路里的小型控制器。她徒手拔掉装置的瞬间，林砚舟已坐进驾驶位，仪表盘刹车警报狂闪，车灯直冲混凝土柱。林晚月扑向墙边总闸，车库骤黑，轮胎擦地尖响后，车头贴着她停下。片尾转到深夜书房，行车记录仪画面定格在乔安然司机碰车的背影；桌上摊开沈清禾药检报告，夹层露出十八年前DNA鉴定。
panels.camera: 车底低机位特写林晚月的手沿备用线路摸索，焦点在指尖与隐藏控制器之间切换；切驾驶舱近景，林砚舟眼神从冷淡转为惊愕，警报红光扫过他的脸。车辆逼近时用低角度正面压迫镜头，林晚月拉闸用高速近景，黑场一瞬后只剩刹车尾音。书房段用静态俯拍证据链：行车记录仪、药检报告、DNA鉴定依次进入焦点，最后停在林砚舟挡在林晚月身前的半身构图。
panels.action: 林晚月咬住袖口，用力拔线，手背被金属划破也不松；林砚舟猛踩刹车，肩颈绷紧，第一次真正失控。车停后，他下车看见她满手血污，原本质问的话卡住。书房里，他把行车记录仪推到众人面前，站到林晚月前方半步；林晚月翻开药检报告夹层，看到DNA鉴定时呼吸停住，林砚舟的眼神也沉下去。
panels.dialogue: 林砚舟低声：碰过车的人，不是她。林晚月看着鉴定书：十八年前……她知道。林砚舟压住情绪：从现在开始，先别信任何人。
panels.sound: 车底金属刮擦声，线路被扯断的噼啪声，仪表盘急促警报，轮胎摩擦地面的刺耳尖啸，拉闸后的瞬间静默；书房里只剩打印纸翻动声和两人压低的呼吸。
panels.emotion: 戏剧目的：改写林砚舟车祸节点，完成林砚舟对林晚月的首次信任转向；同时抛出沈清禾被慢性药物控制与十八年前换婴真相的更深秘密，形成下一集钩子。

episodes.title: 全家命运改写完成
episodes.hook: 系统宣布全家命运改写完成，却揭开终极反转：重生并非天赐外挂，而是前世沈清禾用生命和玉坠为林晚月换来的最后一次机会。
episodes.summary: 林氏周年宴金光璀璨，林怀远却在董事与媒体面前提前发难，甩出林正廷涉嫌违规交易的材料，逼董事会临场改选。乔安然红着眼站到镜头前，控诉自己被林晚月霸凌、被林家抛弃，舆论瞬间倒向她。林正廷脸色惨白，沈清禾指尖发抖，所有人都看向林晚月。她却没有退，直接打开大屏：“今晚，谁都别想再用体面遮丑。”第一段录音，是林怀远指使秘书替换合同；第二条转账链，连到制造林砚舟车祸的空壳公司；第三份病历，证明沈清禾多年被私人医生慢性下药。林怀远反咬她伪造证据，乔安然扑上前哭喊。沈清禾却摘下玉坠，当众承认当年她察觉换婴，却被林怀远用婴儿安全威胁，被药物控制到无人相信。玉坠里最后一段录音响起：林怀远亲口承认乔安然是他的私生女，抱错从一开始就是夺产局。警笛逼近，林怀远被带走，乔安然崩溃冲向林晚月，被林砚舟拦下。林正廷终于低头道歉，沈清禾抱住晚月泣不成声。系统金字浮现：全家命运改写完成。可下一秒，结算画面碎裂，前世火场中，沈清禾跪在她焦黑尸身旁握碎玉坠，低声说：“用我的命，换她重来一次。”林晚月泪水落下，才懂系统不是奖励，是母亲迟来的爱。

shots.visual: 林氏周年宴主厅，金色吊灯压低在画面上方，香槟塔与媒体灯牌形成刺眼反光。林怀远站在舞台中央偏前，身后大屏显示“临时董事议案”，两侧董事席窃语，林正廷坐在主桌脸色发白，沈清禾手指紧攥餐巾。乔安然穿白裙站到记者镜头前，眼眶通红，林晚月在宴会厅后方阴影处被人群隔开，成为所有视线汇聚的终点。
shots.camera: 开场为宴会厅大全景，缓慢推入舞台中央，焦点从璀璨吊灯下移到林怀远手中的文件；切到媒体长焦视角压缩空间，乔安然的泪眼占据前景，林晚月被虚化在远处；最后用低机位拍董事席举手骚动，制造逼宫压迫感。
shots.action: 林怀远将一沓材料摔在发言台上，嘴角保持克制笑意；乔安然深吸一口气，抬手擦泪却故意停在镜头前；林正廷想起身又被旁边董事按住，喉结滚动；沈清禾指尖发抖，玉坠在掌心轻轻磕响；林晚月站定，没有躲开任何目光。
shots.dialogue: 林怀远：“既然大哥不配再坐这个位置，董事会今晚就该给林氏一个交代。” 乔安然：“我只想问一句，被林家承认过的女儿，难道就可以被随便毁掉吗？”

shots.aiPromptEn: English prompt: vertical 9:16 cinematic AI video, consistent character design, suitable for both image-to-video and text-to-video, combining high-end live-action drama performance with polished AI comic-drama detail. Set inside the Lin family anniversary banquet hall: low golden chandeliers, champagne tower, press light boards, whispering directors, a main table, reflective gold-and-white luxury that feels suffocating. Lin Huaiyuan in a dark suit stands at the front of the stage and slams documents onto the podium; behind him, a giant screen shows an emergency board proposal. Lin Zhengting sits pale at the main table, Shen Qinghe in a subdued qipao trembles while clutching a napkin and jade pendant, Qiao Anran in a white dress cries deliberately into reporters’ cameras, and Lin Wanyue in a black formal dress stands in the rear shadows, isolated but steady. Start with a wide banquet establishing shot, slowly push toward the stage, cut to a compressed telephoto media angle with Qiao’s tearful eyes in the foreground and Wanyue blurred behind, then a low angle of directors raising hands. Lights drop; cold white screen light frames Wanyue as she walks through the crowd, shoulder-follow camera, connects her phone, revealing audio waveforms, transaction chains, shell company names, and private medical records. Insert sharp close-ups of evidence, Huaiyuan’s shrinking pupils, Lin Yanzhou guarding the stairs. Qiao rushes forward crying and is blocked by Yanzhou. Shen Qinghe rises, removes the jade pendant, opens the hidden recorder, and exposes the truth: Qiao is Huaiyuan’s illegitimate daughter and the baby swap was planned for inheritance. Police sirens grow louder, red-blue lights cut into the golden hall, Huaiyuan is arrested, Qiao collapses, the father apologizes, the mother embraces Wanyue. Golden system text appears, then shatters like glass into a previous-life fire scene: orange-black ruins, low ground-level camera, Shen Qinghe kneeling beside Wanyue’s burned body, crushing the jade pendant and sacrificing her life for Wanyue’s rebirth. Return to Wanyue’s tearful close-up, victory turning into heartbreak. Rich sound design: shutters, microphone hum, old recording noise, sirens, glass shatter, roaring flames.

shots.action: 林晚月将手机接入投屏，手指稳到几乎没有颤动；第一段录音播放时，林怀远下意识看向秘书席；转账链出现时，林砚舟眼神骤冷，握紧栏杆；病历翻页时，沈清禾肩膀一塌，像终于被人看见了伤口；乔安然脸上的哭意僵住半秒，又强行挤出委屈。
shots.dialogue: 林晚月：“今晚，谁都别想再用体面遮丑。” 林怀远：“伪造证据，也要讲点手段吧？” 林晚月：“那就请你听完，再决定要不要继续演。”
shots.sound: 大屏连接提示音短促冰冷，录音中林怀远压低的旧日声音带有杂音；宾客倒吸气、椅脚摩擦地面、记者连续快门声层层涌起；低频鼓点像心跳一样压在每次证据切换上。
shots.emotion: 戏剧目的：林晚月用真实证据反转战场，逐步洗清父亲违规、哥哥车祸、母亲失控的污名。观众应感到真相不是爆点，而是多年伤害终于被迫见光。

panels.aiPromptEn: English prompt: vertical 9:16 cinematic AI video, consistent character design, suitable for both image-to-video and text-to-video, combining high-end live-action drama performance with polished AI comic-drama detail. Set inside the Lin family anniversary banquet hall: low golden chandeliers, champagne tower, press light boards, whispering directors, a main table, reflective gold-and-white luxury that feels suffocating. Lin Huaiyuan in a dark suit stands at the front of the stage and slams documents onto the podium; behind him, a giant screen shows an emergency board proposal. Lin Zhengting sits pale at the main table, Shen Qinghe in a subdued qipao trembles while clutching a napkin and jade pendant, Qiao Anran in a white dress cries deliberately into reporters’ cameras, and Lin Wanyue in a black formal dress stands in the rear shadows, isolated but steady. Start with a wide banquet establishing shot, slowly push toward the stage, cut to a compressed telephoto media angle with Qiao’s tearful eyes in the foreground and Wanyue blurred behind, then a low angle of directors raising hands. Lights drop; cold white screen light frames Wanyue as she walks through the crowd, shoulder-follow camera, connects her phone, revealing audio waveforms, transaction chains, shell company names, and private medical records. Insert sharp close-ups of evidence, Huaiyuan’s shrinking pupils, Lin Yanzhou guarding the stairs. Qiao rushes forward crying and is blocked by Yanzhou. Shen Qinghe rises, removes the jade pendant, opens the hidden recorder, and exposes the truth: Qiao is Huaiyuan’s illegitimate daughter and the baby swap was planned for inheritance. Police sirens grow louder, red-blue lights cut into the golden hall, Huaiyuan is arrested, Qiao collapses, the father apologizes, the mother embraces Wanyue. Golden system text appears, then shatters like glass into a previous-life fire scene: orange-black ruins, low ground-level camera, Shen Qinghe kneeling beside Wanyue’s burned body, crushing the jade pendant and sacrificing her life for Wanyue’s rebirth. Return to Wanyue’s tearful close-up, victory turning into heartbreak. Rich sound design: shutters, microphone hum, old recording noise, sirens, glass shatter, roaring flames.

panels.visual: 宴会厅灯光骤暗，只剩大屏冷白光照亮林晚月。她走上舞台，与林怀远相距三步，身后屏幕依次跳出合同替换录音波形、转账链路图、空壳公司名称、私人病历扫描件。林正廷的脸在屏幕反光中由惨白转为震动，林砚舟站到台阶下方护住通道，沈清禾的玉坠从掌心滑出半截。
panels.camera: 中近景跟拍林晚月穿过人群，镜头贴近她肩后，前方宾客自动让开形成一条狭窄通道；她抬手点开大屏时切正面特写，冷光切出眼泪未落的轮廓；随后用快速但清晰的插入镜头拍证据细节，再回到林怀远瞳孔收缩的近景。
panels.action: 林晚月将手机接入投屏，手指稳到几乎没有颤动；第一段录音播放时，林怀远下意识看向秘书席；转账链出现时，林砚舟眼神骤冷，握紧栏杆；病历翻页时，沈清禾肩膀一塌，像终于被人看见了伤口；乔安然脸上的哭意僵住半秒，又强行挤出委屈。
panels.dialogue: 林晚月：“今晚，谁都别想再用体面遮丑。” 林怀远：“伪造证据，也要讲点手段吧？” 林晚月：“那就请你听完，再决定要不要继续演。”
panels.sound: 大屏连接提示音短促冰冷，录音中林怀远压低的旧日声音带有杂音；宾客倒吸气、椅脚摩擦地面、记者连续快门声层层涌起；低频鼓点像心跳一样压在每次证据切换上。
panels.emotion: 戏剧目的：林晚月用真实证据反转战场，逐步洗清父亲违规、哥哥车祸、母亲失控的污名。观众应感到真相不是爆点，而是多年伤害终于被迫见光。

panels.visual: 舞台边缘形成三角对峙：林晚月在冷白屏幕前，林怀远在金色灯影下，乔安然扑到二人之间制造混乱。沈清禾缓缓起身，穿过主桌与媒体区，她的旗袍在灯下失去光泽，玉坠被她从颈间摘下举起。所有镜头和目光转向她，宴会厅像被按下静音键。
panels.camera: 先用手持近景跟随乔安然冲向林晚月，画面短暂晃动制造失控；林砚舟入画侧身拦住，镜头停稳；随后切沈清禾的长焦特写，背景人群被压成模糊金色光斑，只保留她发抖的手和玉坠；录音响起时慢慢推近林怀远，直到他脸上的伪装裂开。
panels.action: 乔安然哭喊着伸手去抓林晚月的手腕，林砚舟一步挡住，手臂横在中间但没有碰伤她；沈清禾闭眼一瞬，像吞下一生的恐惧，再睁眼时不再躲闪；她拇指按开玉坠暗扣，里面的微型录音器亮起；林怀远第一次后退半步，脚跟撞到台阶。
panels.dialogue: 沈清禾：“当年我知道孩子被换了。可他说，只要我开口，那个婴儿就活不到天亮。” 玉坠录音里的林怀远：“乔安然本来就是我的女儿，抱错不是意外，是林家该还给我的东西。”
panels.sound: 乔安然的哭喊被林砚舟压低的制止声截断，玉坠暗扣弹开的轻响异常清晰；录音从小小玉坠里传出，带着陈旧磁噪；远处警笛声由弱到强逼近，宴会厅无人说话，只剩沈清禾破碎的呼吸。
panels.emotion: 戏剧目的：沈清禾主动说出沉默真相，完成自我拯救，也将林怀远与乔安然的夺产局钉死。观众应感到母亲不再只是受害者，而是在最公开的地方替女儿夺回身份。

panels.action: 林怀远被押走时仍想回头辩解，却被警员按住肩膀；乔安然跪倒，精致妆容彻底花掉；林正廷嘴唇颤了几次才说出口，眼神不敢直视女儿；沈清禾抱住林晚月，手臂越收越紧；前世火场中，沈清禾用尽最后力气捏碎玉坠，额头贴在女儿焦黑的手边；现实里的林晚月眼泪落下，表情从胜利变成迟来的心碎。
panels.dialogue: 林正廷：“晚月，对不起，是我把你一个人留在了外面。” 沈清禾：“我的女儿，妈妈终于接住你了。” 前世沈清禾：“用我的命，换她重来一次。”
panels.sound: 警笛声、手铐轻响、记者混乱追问逐渐远去；系统提示音空灵而短暂，随即被玻璃碎裂声撕开；火场里木梁坍塌、烈焰呼啸、玉坠碎裂声与现实中林晚月泪水落在母亲肩头的细小声响重叠。
panels.emotion: 戏剧目的：完成现实清算与家庭和解，同时揭示终极反转——系统不是奖励，而是母亲以命换来的重来机会。观众应从胜利快感转入强烈泪点，理解林晚月真正被改写的不是命运，而是她终于看见了母亲迟来的爱。

panels.aiPromptEn: English prompt: vertical 9:16 cinematic AI video, consistent character design, suitable for both image-to-video and text-to-video, combining high-end live-action drama performance with polished AI comic-drama detail. Set inside the Lin family anniversary banquet hall: low golden chandeliers, champagne tower, press light boards, whispering directors, a main table, reflective gold-and-white luxury that feels suffocating. Lin Huaiyuan in a dark suit stands at the front of the stage and slams documents onto the podium; behind him, a giant screen shows an emergency board proposal. Lin Zhengting sits pale at the main table, Shen Qinghe in a subdued qipao trembles while clutching a napkin and jade pendant, Qiao Anran in a white dress cries deliberately into reporters’ cameras, and Lin Wanyue in a black formal dress stands in the rear shadows, isolated but steady. Start with a wide banquet establishing shot, slowly push toward the stage, cut to a compressed telephoto media angle with Qiao’s tearful eyes in the foreground and Wanyue blurred behind, then a low angle of directors raising hands. Lights drop; cold white screen light frames Wanyue as she walks through the crowd, shoulder-follow camera, connects her phone, revealing audio waveforms, transaction chains, shell company names, and private medical records. Insert sharp close-ups of evidence, Huaiyuan’s shrinking pupils, Lin Yanzhou guarding the stairs. Qiao rushes forward crying and is blocked by Yanzhou. Shen Qinghe rises, removes the jade pendant, opens the hidden recorder, and exposes the truth: Qiao is Huaiyuan’s illegitimate daughter and the baby swap was planned for inheritance. Police sirens grow louder, red-blue lights cut into the golden hall, Huaiyuan is arrested, Qiao collapses, the father apologizes, the mother embraces Wanyue. Golden system text appears, then shatters like glass into a previous-life fire scene: orange-black ruins, low ground-level camera, Shen Qinghe kneeling beside Wanyue’s burned body, crushing the jade pendant and sacrificing her life for Wanyue’s rebirth. Return to Wanyue’s tearful close-up, victory turning into heartbreak. Rich sound design: shutters, microphone hum, old recording noise, sirens, glass shatter, roaring flames.
